{{- $destination := .Destination -}} {{- $isAbsolute := or (strings.HasPrefix $destination "http://") (strings.HasPrefix $destination "https://") (strings.HasPrefix $destination "mailto:") (strings.HasPrefix $destination "tel:") (strings.HasPrefix $destination "//") -}} {{- if and (strings.HasPrefix $destination "/") (not $isAbsolute) -}} {{- $destination = relURL (strings.TrimPrefix "/" $destination) -}} {{- end -}} {{- $target := "" -}} {{- $rel := "" -}} {{- if $isAbsolute -}} {{- $target = " target=\"_blank\"" -}} {{- $rel = " rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"" -}} {{- end -}} {{ .Text | safeHTML }} {{- /* The trim above swallows this file's trailing newline. Left in, it renders as a space between a link and the punctuation that follows it: "see Filters ." */ -}}
